scripts.db:tables: docker exec supabase_db_consist psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name;"
scripts.db:feedback: docker exec supabase_db_consist psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT difficulty_score, actual_duration_mins, feedback_tags, created_at FROM task_feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;"
scripts.db:status: docker exec supabase_db_consist psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT schemaname, tablename, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename)) AS size FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename) DESC;"
scripts.db:connect: docker exec -it supabase_db_consist psql -U postgres -d postgres
